title: A better inbox for support teams
thesis: Support inboxes are frustrating and a better one would win.
note: A large, well-funded incumbent that customers grumble about but keep paying.

evidence.title: Team pays the incumbent and complains about it
evidence.body: We pay about 400 a month for it and grumble constantly, but nobody is going to migrate three years of history.

evidence.title: Switching cost described plainly
evidence.body: The migration alone would take a fortnight of somebody's time, which is more than the annoyance is worth.

evidence.title: Incumbent ships the most-requested feature
evidence.body: The feature everyone asked for shipped last month, which took the wind out of the complaints.
